# Locators that commit C5b moves onto the finder: the Pinned section and pin parsing (S12-S18, S29-S33).
# Format: path<TAB>function<TAB>kind<TAB>expression. Delete an entry in the commit
# that routes its site through hooks/shared/claude_md_markers.py.

# hooks/pin_caps.py _extract_body_chars: S17
hooks/pin_caps.py	_extract_body_chars	.sub	_DATE_COMMENT_RE.sub("", line)
hooks/pin_caps.py	_extract_body_chars	.sub	_STALE_MARKER_RE.sub("", stripped)
hooks/pin_caps.py	_extract_body_chars	line split	body.splitlines()
# hooks/pin_caps.py parse_pins: S13, S17

hooks/pin_caps.py	parse_pins	.fullmatch	OVERRIDE_COMMENT_RE.fullmatch(candidate)
hooks/pin_caps.py	parse_pins	.fullmatch	_DATE_COMMENT_RE.fullmatch(candidate)
hooks/pin_caps.py	parse_pins	.search	_STALE_MARKER_RE.search(body)
hooks/pin_caps.py	parse_pins	==	nl_pos == -1
hooks/pin_caps.py	parse_pins	line split	preceding.rstrip("\n").splitlines()

hooks/staleness.py	_parse_pinned_section	helper call	_find_terminator_offset( scan_text, pinned_start, next_section_pattern )
